Name: Poop Framework
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod lets you use Content Patcher to cause any Character to have a chance to poop any item at any interval.

The mod also supports designated toilet furniture that will dispose of the poop when the character is sitting on it, instead of having it drop on the ground.

The mod also shows a warning emote a certain number of minutes before pooping (default "[b]sad[/b]", [b]30[/b] minutes before).


[b][size=5]Poop[/size][/b]

Poop types can be added using Content Patcher by targeting [b]"aedenthorn.PoopFramework/poop"[/b].

Here's an example content.json file:

[code]﻿{
    "Format": "1.29.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.PoopFramework/poop",
            "Entries": {
                "TrashPoop": {
                    "poopItem" : "168",
                    "poopSound" : "dwoop",
                    "poopEmote" : "happy",
                    "poopChance" : "50",
                    "poopInterval" : "180",
                    "bigCraftablePoop" : false,
                    "pooper" : "Farmer"
                }
            }
        }
    ]
}[/code]
[b]pooper[/b] should work with the following types:

[list]
[*]Farmer[/*]
[*]NPC[/*]
[*]Cat[/*]
[*]Dog[/*]
[*]FarmAnimal[/*]
[*]Child[/*]
[/list]
It should also work with any specific monster type (e.g. [b]Bat[/b]).

You can also specify the character's name (e.g. [b]Abigail[/b]).
[b]
poopItem[/b] can be either the ItemId or QualifiiedItemId.
[b]poopSound[/b] can be any built in sound cue.
[b]poopEmote[/b] can be the name of any emote command name.
[b]poopChance[/b] is out of 100 - multiple poop types can compete for being pooped, only one will be pooped per interval.

An example of a mod that adds poop is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17153]Mayo Poop[/url].


[b][size=5]Toilets[/size][/b]

Toilets can be added using Content Patcher by targeting [b]"aedenthorn.PoopFramework/toilets"[/b].

Here's an example content.json file:

[code]﻿{
    "Format": "1.29.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.PoopFramework/toilets",
            "Entries": {
                "himewildflour.bathroomfurniture": {
                    "toiletNameOrId": "himewildflour.bathroomfurniture/Toilet"
                }
            }
        }
    ]
}[/code]
